notes:
### Fixed

- **A shop that had imported its data from another program could not restore any backup.** The restore stopped at «Po kontrollohen lidhjet mes të dhënave» with the database's own sentence — `insert or update on table "import_runs" violates foreign key constraint "import_runs_backup_id_fkey"` — on every PC, also on the PC the backup was made on, with the packed file and with the JSON file alike. Nothing was changed by the failed restore. The cause: «Importo nga program tjetër» takes a safety backup first and remembers which one; the list of backups is the one thing a restore does not take from the file (it lists the files on this disk), and it was put back only after the references had been checked — so the import pointed at a backup that was not there yet. It has been so since the import was added (0.15.0). Now the list of this PC's backups goes back first; on the same PC the import keeps pointing at its safety backup, and on another PC, where that file does not exist, the import simply no longer points at one. **Backup files made before this update restore as they are** — nothing has to be made again; the PC that receives the file needs this version.
- **Restoring from the login screen of a PC that has an owner of its own failed at the very last step** (`audit_logs_actor_user_id_fkey`): the restore noted who had started it, and that account — one of the PC being restored onto — is not among the accounts in the backup. It was hidden behind the error above. The note is now written with the user name only when the account is not in the restored data.
- A backup in which a row really points at something that is not there is now refused in words that name the table and say that nothing was changed (`ARCHIVE_REFERENCES_BROKEN`), instead of the database's sentence.
- «Backup file» now says that the other PC needs LIKApcs **0.41.1** or newer (it said 0.41.0). No migration; nothing else changed in the Admin, and nothing in the gaming PC, the phone app or the tablet.
